import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,base64,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();a=json.loads((p/'original-provenance.json').read_text())
for x in a:
 raw=base64.b64decode(x['raw_base64']);o=json.loads(raw);m=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',raw);t=m.group(1);s=o['statement'].encode();x.update(statement_token_base64=base64.b64encode(t).decode(),statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(t).hexdigest(),statement=o['statement'],statement_sha256=hashlib.sha256(s).hexdigest(),source_url=o['source_url'])
 print(o['mathdb_id'],o['title'],'\n',o['statement'],'\nSOURCE',o['source_url'],'FIRST',o['first_stated_year_source_url'])
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'original-provenance.json'],input=json.dumps(a,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print('TASKMID', (p/'TASK.txt').read_text()[7000:10000])
d=json.loads((p/'inherited-denials.json').read_text());print('DENIED_KEYS',json.dumps(d.get('blocked_keys')));print('DENIED_ARTIFACTS',json.dumps(d.get('blocked_artifacts')))
